pr_title: multitenant: move RELOCATE LEASE tenant check from SQL to KV layer
pr_body:
Fixes #93452
    
Move the {EXPERIMENTAL_}RELOCATE LEASE tenant check from the SQL to KV layer
to prepare for tenant capabilities work. This check will eventually be replaced
by a tenant capabilities lookup to determine if the tenant can perform the
requested KV operation (AdmTransferLease in this case). `Codec.ForSystemTenant()`
checks still exist in the SQL and will be handled in separate PRs.
    
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/93453)

issue_context.title: multitenant: move RELOCATE LEASE tenant check from SQL to KV layer
issue_context.body:
Move the check for these statements from `execFactory.ConstructAlterRangeRelocate` to `reqAllowed`.
```
ALTER RANGE x RELOCATE LEASE
ALTER RANGE RELOCATE LEASE
```
Move the check for these statements from `execFactory.ConstructAlterTableRelocate` to `reqAllowed`.
```
ALTER TABLE x EXPERIMENTAL_RELOCATE LEASE
```
